units.source_text: 他架好照相机，正在这时，脚下的沙子唰唰地流动起来。

en.t: He had set up the camera, and just then the sand beneath his feet began to flow with a soft rustling sound.

units.source_text: 他打了个寒噤，赶快把脚收回来，沙的流动却丝毫没有停止的迹象。

en.t: He shuddered and quickly pulled his feet back, but the movement of the sand showed not the slightest sign of stopping.

units.source_text: 多么微妙而危险的平衡呵。

en.t: What a delicate and dangerous balance it was.

units.source_text: 他有些上气不接下气了，粗糙的手掌不停地在裤脚管上搓着。

en.t: He was beginning to pant a little, and his rough palms kept rubbing against the legs of his trousers.
